title: Auto farm Auto fishing Auto event 2026 auto mob/res and more
features:
🎃 Halloween Event ( For Buyers )

Auto Pumpkin Smasher — Fly to and smash pumpkins. Adjust Fly Speed / Hit Delay.

Auto Ghost Catcher — Chase and catch ghosts. Adjust Fly Speed / Catch Distance.

Auto Trick or Treat — Visit houses for candy. Adjust Fly Speed / Retry Delay.

Auto Community Cauldron — Contribute automatically. Adjust Fly Speed / Work Delay.

Auto Event Fishing — Auto-fish in selected zones; rescan zones anytime.

Auto Event Chests — Collect Spooky Chests without keys.

Auto Egg Tomb — Buy eggs with Candy, chase egg-stealing ghosts, and retrieve eggs.

📍 Main — Core Farming

Select Monsters — Scan workspace.MobFolder every 2s; dedupe and sort A–Z. Leave empty to target all mobs.

Auto Farm Monster — Fly to the nearest selected mob, warp nearby, lock 15 studs above it, and breathe fire until defeated.

Select Farm Type — Multi-select Food / Ore / Bone Meal.

Auto Farm Resources — Freeze nodes, expand hitbox to 15³, and attack silently. Starts Map Patrol when no nodes remain.

Select Chest Type — Choose Silver / Bronze / Gold.

Auto Chest Farm — Fly to the nearest chest, lock position, attack until broken, then auto-open and collect drops.

Auto Collect Egg — Scan Eggs/ActiveNodes, visit each node, and try IDs 1–16 until claimed.

Smart Auto Feed — When hunger falls below 35%, use available food (12 types) until hunger reaches 100%.

Smart Auto Bond — Detect Bored / Dirty / Low Happiness / Lonely and trigger the matching care action.

🎣 Auto Fishing

Select Fishing Zone — Choose from 7 preset zones, from Lobby to deep areas.

Enable Auto Fishing — Fish automatically without riding your dragon; handles clicks and catch detection.

⚙️ Misc — Movement & Performance

Speed Hack — CFrame speed boost, adjustable 1–20.

Infinite Jump — Keep pressing Space to jump in mid-air.

Safe Noclip — Pass through objects with ground raycasting to help prevent falling.

God Mode (Desktop) — Ghost mode that prevents damage (PC only).

Mega Dash — Adjust dash power from 100–1000.

Infinite Fire Breath — Refill BreathFuel continuously.

Semi-God Mode — Restore Health to MaxHealth every second.

Anti-AFK — Prevent idle kick.

Potato Mode — Disable shadows, fog, and particles; force SmoothPlastic for better FPS.

Rejoin / Server Hop — Rejoin or find smaller servers via the Roblox games API.

🌐 AutoQuest World

AutoQuest — 11 Worlds — Per-world toggles with ghost protection, auto-loot magnet, boss kills, ring flight, and resource/chest/egg missions.

Supported Worlds: Origins, Grassland, Jungle, Volcano, Tundra, Ocean, Desert, Fantasy, Wasteland, Prehistoric, Shinrin.

🌍 Teleport

Instant Teleport — 12 Worlds — One-click travel from Lobby to Shinrin and Undercity. Undercity (4601778915) uses TeleportService as a separate Place.

🏙️ Undercity — Black Market

Enable Market Stall — Open your stall and fly to (-986, 357, -608) with noclip.

Auto Refill — Claim sold items and refill the board every 3–60s.

Sell Settings — Set Item Name, Item Type (Food/Resources/Potions/Eggs/Healing/Tools), and Board Price.

Max Slots / Refill Interval — Set 1–5 sale slots and the check interval.

Fill Board Now — Claim old sales and list new items.

Claim Money Now — Collect all pending money.

Clear Board — Remove listings slot-by-slot.

🛒 Store & Spin

Spin Wheel — Spin and claim rewards in one click.

Shop — 35 Items — Buy without walking to the shop:

🧪 Potions: ×14

🍖 Food: ×6

💊 Healing: ×6

🧱 Resources: ×6

🛠️ Tools: ×3

👁️ Visuals — ESP V3
